title: Finalize coarse mip0 layout to match descriptor for mesh draws (fix residual 09600)
purpose: Stop the persistent VUID-09600 on mip 0 by ensuring the descriptor-written layout equals the actual layout at mesh draw time.

steps.detail: Choose one layout for sampling in mesh (GENERAL or SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL). Prefer GENERAL for storage+sampling; write descriptors with that layout.

At end of coarse update/mip gen, transition mip0 to the chosen layout and set m_coarseMipLayouts[0] and m_coarseDescriptorLayout accordingly. Do not log contradictory 'Starting ... transitioning from SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL' lines afterwards.
Avoid clearing and switching layouts every frame; only clear when necessary (e.g., on extract ticks).

acceptance: No VUID-09600 during mesh draws for mip 0
Logs no longer show alternating 'expects SROO, current GENERAL'
